reference.code: pub fn allocate_fixed(t:i32,w:&[i32])->Option<Vec<i32>>{if t<0||t>10000000||w.is_empty()||w.iter().any(|x|*x<0||*x>10000000){return None}let s:i64=w.iter().map(|x|*x as i64).sum();if s==0||s>10000000{return None}let mut o:Vec<i32>=w.iter().map(|x|((t as i64)*(*x as i64)/s)as i32).collect();let left=t-o.iter().sum::<i32>();let mut q:Vec<_>=(0..w.len()).collect();q.sort_by_key(|&i|(-(((t as i64)*(w[i] as i64)%s)as i32),i));for i in 0..left as usize{o[q[i]]+=1}Some(o)}
